title: Zed 编辑器发布 Delta：新一代协作编辑引擎
summary: Zed 团队在官方博客上发布了名为 Delta 的新一代协作编辑引擎。Delta 旨在解决传统协作编辑中存在的延迟、冲突和扩展性问题，通过重新设计底层数据结构和同步协议，实现了更高效的实时协作体验。该引擎支持多人同时编辑同一文档，并提供了细粒度的操作合并和冲突解决机制，显著降低了网络延迟对协作流畅度的影响。Delta 还引入了可插拔的存储后端和更灵活的权限模型，使得 Zed 能够更好地适应从个人项目到大型团队的不同使用场景。文章详细介绍了 Delta 的技术架构，包括基于 CRDT（无冲突复制数据类型）的改进方案、增量同步算法以及本地优先的缓存策略。此外，Delta 还优化了内存占用和 CPU 使用率，提升了大型文件的编辑性能。Zed 团队表示，Delta 将作为未来版本的核心组件，并计划开源部分实现以促进社区协作。该发布引发了开发者社区的广泛讨论，评论中既有对技术创新的肯定，也有对兼容性和迁移成本的关注。总体而言，Delta 代表了协作编辑领域的一次重要技术演进，有望推动编辑器行业向更高效、更实时的方向发展。
summary_en: Zed team announced Delta, a next-generation collaborative editing engine, in their official blog. Delta aims to address latency, conflict, and scalability issues in traditional collaborative editing by redesigning the underlying data structure and synchronization protocol, enabling more efficient real-time collaboration. It supports multi-user editing with fine-grained operation merging and conflict resolution, significantly reducing the impact of network latency. Delta also introduces pluggable storage backends and flexible permission models, adapting to scenarios from personal projects to large teams. The article details its technical architecture, including improved CRDT-based approaches, incremental sync algorithms, and local-first caching strategies. Additionally, Delta optimizes memory and CPU usage, enhancing performance for large files. Zed plans to make Delta a core component in future releases and open-source parts of the implementation. The announcement sparked community discussion, with both praise for innovation and concerns about compatibility and migration costs. Overall, Delta represents a significant technical evolution in collaborative editing, potentially driving the industry toward more efficient and real-time experiences.
